title: Ninety-five Theses
description: Martin Luther sparks the Protestant Reformation.

title: Copernicus publishes heliocentric model
description: De revolutionibus orbium coelestium is printed.

title: Jamestown founded
description: First permanent English settlement in North America.

title: Newton's Principia
description: Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy is published.

title: U.S. Declaration of Independence
description: The Thirteen Colonies declare independence from Great Britain.

title: French Revolution begins
description: Storming of the Bastille on July 14.

title: Haiti gains independence
description: First independent Black-led republic in the Americas.

title: On the Origin of Species
description: Darwin publishes his theory of evolution by natural selection.

title: End of the U.S. Civil War
description: Confederate surrender at Appomattox; slavery abolished by 13th Amendment.

title: Edison's incandescent bulb
description: First practical long-lasting electric light bulb.

title: Wright brothers' first flight
description: First successful powered, controlled airplane flight.

title: World War I begins
description: Assassination in Sarajevo triggers global war.

title: World War I
description: Global war, 1914–1918.

title: World War II
description: Global war, 1939–1945.

title: Cold War
description: Geopolitical tension between US and Soviet blocs.

title: World War II begins
description: Germany invades Poland.

title: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
description: First use of nuclear weapons in war; Japan surrenders days later.

title: Sputnik launched
description: First artificial Earth satellite.

title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
description: Humans land on the Moon for the first time.

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description: Symbolic end of the Cold War divide in Europe.

title: World Wide Web goes public
description: Tim Berners-Lee publishes the first website.

title: iPhone introduced
description: Apple launches the smartphone era at scale.

title: COVID-19 pandemic
description: WHO declares a global pandemic.
